"""Core task operations. due_at throughout this module is in SECONDS, matching models.Task."""
import time

from tinytasks.models import Task
from tinytasks.storage import load_all, next_id, save_all


def create_task(title: str, due_in_seconds: float) -> Task:
    """Create a task due `due_in_seconds` seconds from now."""
    tasks = load_all()
    task = Task(id=next_id(tasks), title=title, due_at=time.time() + due_in_seconds)
    tasks.append(task)
    save_all(tasks)
    return task


def get_overdue_tasks(now: float | None = None) -> list[Task]:
    """Tasks whose due_at (seconds) has already passed."""
    now = now if now is not None else time.time()
    return [t for t in load_all() if t.due_at < now and not t.archived]


def delete_task(task_id: int) -> bool:
    tasks = load_all()
    remaining = [t for t in tasks if t.id != task_id]
    save_all(remaining)
    return len(remaining) != len(tasks)


def archive_task(task_id: int) -> bool:
    """Soft-delete a task: mark it archived and keep the record."""
    tasks = load_all()
    for t in tasks:
        if t.id == task_id:
            t.archived = True
            save_all(tasks)
            return True
    return False
import argparse

from tinytasks.api import create_task, delete_task, get_overdue_tasks
from tinytasks.text import normalize_title


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="tinytasks")
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    p_add = sub.add_parser("add")
    p_add.add_argument("title")
    p_add.add_argument("--due-in", type=float, required=True, help="seconds from now")

    sub.add_parser("overdue")

    p_del = sub.add_parser("delete")
    p_del.add_argument("id", type=int)

    a = ap.parse_args()
    if a.cmd == "add":
        t = create_task(normalize_title(a.title), a.due_in)
        print(f"created task {t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "overdue":
        for t in get_overdue_tasks():
            print(f"{t.id}: {t.title} (due_at={t.due_at})")
    elif a.cmd == "delete":
        print("deleted" if delete_task(a.id) else "no such task")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass
class Task:
    id: int
    title: str
    due_at: float  # unix timestamp, seconds
    archived: bool = False
import time

from tinytasks.api import archive_task, create_task, delete_task, get_overdue_tasks
from tinytasks.storage import load_all


def _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("TINYTASKS_DATA", str(tmp_path / "data.json"))


def test_create_task_sets_due_at_seconds_from_now(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    before = time.time()
    t = create_task("write report", due_in_seconds=3600)
    assert 3500 < t.due_at - before < 3700


def test_overdue_tasks_filters_by_due_at(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("already late", due_in_seconds=-10)
    create_task("not yet", due_in_seconds=10000)
    overdue = get_overdue_tasks()
    assert [t.title for t in overdue] == ["already late"]


def test_delete_task_removes_it(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("temp", due_in_seconds=60)
    assert delete_task(t.id) is True
    assert load_all() == []


def test_archive_task_keeps_record(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("keep me", due_in_seconds=60)
    assert archive_task(t.id) is True
    tasks = load_all()
    assert len(tasks) == 1 and tasks[0].archived is True


def test_archive_task_unknown_id(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    assert archive_task(999) is False


def test_overdue_skips_archived(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    t = create_task("late but archived", due_in_seconds=-10)
    archive_task(t.id)
    assert get_overdue_tasks() == []

import sys
import time

from tinytasks import cli
from tinytasks.api import clear_overdue, create_task, get_overdue_tasks
from tinytasks.storage import load_all


def _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("TINYTASKS_DATA", str(tmp_path / "data.json"))


def _run(monkeypatch, *args):
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["tinytasks", *args])
    cli.main()


def test_clear_overdue_archives_and_counts(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("late1", -10)
    create_task("late2", -20)
    create_task("later", 10000)
    assert clear_overdue() == 2
    assert get_overdue_tasks() == []
    tasks = load_all()
    assert len(tasks) == 3
    assert sum(t.archived for t in tasks) == 2
    assert clear_overdue() == 0


def test_clear_overdue_cli_prints_count(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    create_task("late", -10)
    _run(monkeypatch, "clear-overdue")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "1"


def test_quick_add_due_in_24h_and_normalized(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
    _isolate(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    from tinytasks.text import normalize_title
    raw = "  Buy   milk  "
    before = time.time()
    _run(monkeypatch, "quick-add", raw)
    (t,) = load_all()
    assert 86400 - 100 < t.due_at - before < 86400 + 100
    assert t.title == normalize_title(raw)
